content.summary: A marine guide reveals a tidal lab and water channels during one selfie walk. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult marine guide in an arm-length selfie along a coastal research station path. Use one measured side turn to reveal the complete tidal lab while preserving walking direction. Return to her complete face with the tidal lab and channels still registered behind her.

invariants.rule: One adult identity, selfie distance and walking direction remain fixed.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.rule: Background evidence accumulates rather than jumping between locations.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Background evidence accumulates rather than jumping between locations."

invariants.rule: One continuous turn reveals the primary destination.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One continuous turn reveals the primary destination."

invariants.rule: A secondary facility appears within the same geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A secondary facility appears within the same geography."

invariants.rule: The final face view retains enough destination context to prove the route.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final face view retains enough destination context to prove the route."
